author: CNN
description:
Lebanese President Joseph Aoun delivered a searing rebuke to Iran on Friday, accusing it of using his country as a bargaining chip against the wishes of the Lebanese people in the conflict with the United States and Israel.

In a rare and exclusive interview with CNN’s Christiane Amanpour, President Aoun declared that he is committed to doing “whatever it takes” to save his country from conflict, and that the Lebanese people are “fed up” with war between Israel and Hezbollah, a heavily armed Iranian-backed proxy that has built strong domestic support by portraying itself as the defender of southern Lebanon and the Palestinian people.

0:00 Lebanese President Joseph Aoun speaks exclusively with CNN's Christiane Amanpour
2:10 Aoun: "This is a huge opportunity. Both sides have to choose: war or diplomacy."
3:28 Aoun: Israel's "strategy is short-sighted"
6:17 Aoun: Iran is "using Lebanon as a bargaining chip in their negotiation with the United States"
9:45 Amanpour: "Are you powerless?"
title: Lebanese president calls out Israel-Hezbollah war as 'futile'

author: CNN
description:
It was three days before the filing deadline when Alaska Sen. Dan Sullivan learned of an eleventh-hour Republican challenger in his high-stakes reelection race. 

The challenger’s name: Dan J. Sullivan. 

The two-term Republican incumbent, and the GOP’s Senate campaign arm, are raising major alarms about his same-name rival, warning that it could cost them a seat by confusing the electorate and give a leg-up to his well-funded Democratic challenger, former Rep. Mary Peltola. 

CNN’s Manu Raju speaks with Sen. Sullivan, and an Inside Politics panel weighs in on the senator’s allegation that his opponent's candidacy equates to cheating. 

0:00 Who is Dan J. Sullivan? 
1:15 Incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan (R-AK) accuses Democrats of being behind effort to cheat in his election 
3:05 Sen. Sullivan compares his campaign logo to Dan J. Sullivan’s logo 
6:17 Democratic senate challenger Mary Peltola responds to allegation that she was involved in Dan J. Sullivan’s candidacy 

Watch more CNN here
title: Sen. Dan Sullivan reacts to last-minute challenger with same name

description: At least one person was killed and several wounded in Kochav Yair in central Israel, according to emergency responders. Police said they were investigating the shooting as a suspected terror attack after they "neutralized" the suspect. An Israeli security source said the suspect was a Palestinian citizen of Israel from Tayibe, an Arab town just north of Kochav Yair. CNN’s Jeremy Diamond reports. #cnn, #news
title: One killed in suspected terror attack in Israel

author: CNN
description: A violent weekend unfolded in the West Bank, with Israeli soldiers and settlers killing or wounding multiple Palestinians. In Huwara, an Israeli soldier joined Israeli settlers who infiltrated the town and wounded at least nine Palestinians. Israeli soldiers also opened fire on a civilian vehicle in Hebron, killing a 7-month old baby. The Israeli military said the incidents are under review. CNN’s Jeremy Diamond reports.
title: Israeli soldier beats Palestinian, joining settler attack
